mapper.select: SELECT uc.id, uc.user_id, uc.target_id as scenic_id, uc.content, uc.is_audit, uc.create_time, u.username, u.avatar FROM user_comment uc LEFT JOIN user u ON uc.user_id = u.id WHERE uc.target_id = #{scenicId} AND uc.type = 1 AND uc.is_audit = 1 ORDER BY uc.create_time DESC
